editorial:
Imagine being a great cop with a perfect life, only to lose everything in one split second. That is exactly what happens to Simon. He and his partner, Franck, are the best in the business until a drunk driving accident ruins Simon's career and leaves him with a heavy load of guilt. The vibe here is gritty and tense, making you feel the pressure Simon is under as he tries to move on. It is a story about friendship, mistakes, and how far a man will go to protect the people he loves when the law can no longer help him.

What really works is the pacing; it moves fast and keeps you guessing with some solid twists. The acting feels real, and the action scenes are punchy without being over the top. One small downside is that some plot points feel a bit rushed, but it does not ruin the ride. You should definitely watch this if you love crime stories with a lot of heart.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that Franck was actually manipulating things to get revenge. He wanted Simon to suffer for the past. The final showdown is a tense battle of wits and strength. Simon manages to outsmart Franck and protect his family, finally clearing his name and finding peace. It wraps up with a feeling of justice, showing that while you cannot erase your mistakes, you can still fight for what is right.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves police thrillers and stories about redemption.
